product.title: Yosemite Valley Private Hiking Tour

description.text: Design your own Yosemite Valley adventure on a private hiking tour for your group. A local guide customizes the route to your interests—waterfall walks, meadow strolls, or moderate climbs—with insider knowledge of less-crowded trails.

highlights: Private tour for your group only
Local guide with insider trail knowledge
Ideal for families and special occasions

start.description: Meet your private guide at a Yosemite Valley meeting point agreed at booking.

end.description: Return to the agreed meeting point after your custom hike.
